author: fester
body: Each type def emits once by name. Codex refuses duplicate type names program-wide (CDX3001), so a repeated name in the parsed list can only be the IR parser's placeholder for a type-def kind it does not model - every unit-def parses to an empty record named Unknown - and emitting the placeholder twice is invalid C#. The first occurrence wins; nothing references the placeholder, it exists only so the emitted source is complete.

author: fester
body: A definition whose name is a platform-seam override (Platform Seam Overrides, CSharpEmitterExpressions) is not emitted at all: its call sites are rewritten to the runtime preamble, so its native body would be dead code in the C# output.

author: fester
body: The seam preambles are emitted only when the compiled module actually defines the seam functions - the arity map carries every def in the IR, so membership there is the exact condition. Modules that never cite the seam chapter produce byte-identical output with no barbarian package dependencies.
